title: Ryan International Airlines 590
summary: A McDonnell Douglas DC-9-15RC cargo flight crashed on takeoff from Cleveland Hopkins International Airport during icing conditions. The flight crew failing to deice their aircraft contributed to the accident. The captain had 10,505 flight hours including 505 hours on the DC-9, while the first officer had 3,820 flight hours including 510 hours on the DC-9. Both pilots were killed when the aircraft rolled 90 degrees to the left and entered a stall shortly after liftoff.
probable_cause: The causes of the crash were the flight crew failing to deice their aircraft, and the inexperience of the Federal Aviation Administration, McDonnell Douglas, and Ryan International Airlines with icing condition on DC-9-10 aircraft.
